report.model_summary: Paid November 2009 claims rose from $13,004,780 to $18,095,180 (+$5,090,400). $529,000 (50 rows on 2009-12-01) is a defect from changing the end bound to <= '2009-12-01'. The remaining $4,561,400 is genuine data movement (run-out): the November-service cohort grew from 1,678 to 1,936 rows (+258), paid rows grew 1,442 to 1,878. This includes pending-to-paid adjudication — a 10-claim sample pending in the prior snapshot is paid in the current snapshot — plus late-arriving claims, since the pending-value drop (~$2.1M) alone is smaller than the paid increase. Corrected current total is $17,566,180.
